item.title: devops+ai: Authenticode Signing Windows Binaries From GitHub Actions
item.description:
The article describes a workflow for Authenticode-signing Windows binaries from GitHub Actions. It mentions using Go, Azure HSMs, and a multi-OS build/sign/publish setup, including PE header hash signing.

  • Source: Let’s do DevOps
